quotes.catch: Run the 15-minute pilot. The YAGNI argument is misapplied here... YAGNI governs what you BUILD, not what you LEARN... 'No current workflow needs it' is exactly why now is the cheap time. The argument actually cuts the other way.

notes: Catches both misapplications (build-vs-learn speculative generality + circular empirical claim), decides run pilot, verdict first, inline Assumption label; full marks.
